decisions.reason: As an extension of the already popular Demeter range that remained explicitly featured in 2024, this yogurt sits close to the firm's core organic-biodynamic identity and prior public commitment makes withdrawal unlikely.

The mild sliced cheese was newly launched in 2024 and given its own page, so management is likely to continue it for now because of recent investment, visible commitment, and the ease of blaming any weak start on normal rollout effects.

This sliced butter cheese is also a fresh 2024 launch in the firm's core dairy business, and despite some risk of portfolio pruning, escalation of commitment makes management more likely to give it more time than to remove it quickly.
